title: Senior Electrical BIM/VDC
description:
**You know what great electrical BIM talent actually looks like. Now help us build the system that finds it.**


We’re looking for a senior electrical BIM/VDC professional to help build and lead the technical side of a specialized recruiting service for U.S. electrical contractors.


This starts as a **paid four\-week fractional project (10–20 hours/week)**, with the potential to grow into an ongoing fractional or full\-time leadership role.

**Location:**Fully Remote

**Your Mission: Day to Day Responsibilities**

* Define technical requirements for electrical BIM modelers, senior coordinators and team leads.
* Train recruiters on BIM/VDC terminology, software, project types and relevant experience.
* Build résumé and portfolio screening standards.
* Develop technical interview questions, evaluation criteria and scorecards.
* Design a practical **Revit/Navisworks candidate assessment**.
* Review portfolios and interview shortlisted candidates.
* Grade technical assessments and calibrate candidate quality.
* Help establish market\-based compensation benchmarks.
* Identify the first **3–5 candidates** who are ready to confidently present to U.S. electrical contractors.
* Help create a repeatable technical recruiting process that can scale.

**Your Toolbox: Skills to be Successful**

**Must have:**

* 7\+ years of BIM/VDC experience.
* Strong electrical or MEP specialization.
* Advanced proficiency with **Revit MEP and Navisworks Manage**.
* Commercial or industrial construction experience.
* Experience supporting **U.S., Canadian, Australian or UK projects**.
* Experience reviewing, training or managing BIM modelers.
* Strong English communication skills.
* A sharp understanding of the difference between **design modeling and construction\-ready coordination/detailing**.

**Strongly preferred:**

* Experience with a BIM outsourcing company.
* U.S. electrical\-contractor experience.
* Data center, hospital or advanced manufacturing experience.
* Experience creating technical hiring assessments.
* Client\-facing coordination experience.
* Autodesk Construction Cloud, BIM 360 or Bluebeam experience.

**Why Adaptive Teams?**  

At Adaptive Teams, we don’t just fill positions – we create pathways to success. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, we’re here to help you grow, innovate, and make an impact. If you’re looking for exciting opportunities and, a team that’s as passionate as you are, this is the place to be.

 **What to Expect from Our Application Process?**  

Once you apply, you’ll receive an email guiding you through the next steps, including an assessment tailored to the role. Be sure to **check your inbox** (and **your spam folder**, just in case) for further instructions.  

  

We understand **your time is valuable**, so we strive to keep the assessment process **under 45 minutes** whenever possible, though some roles may require a slightly longer time investment.  

  

Once selected, you’ll have the chance to **schedule your first interview** with our team. We aim to make the process as smooth and transparent as possible, so you’ll always know where you stand.

title: Global Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
**About the Role**



Globalli is seeking an experienced Global Talent Acquisition Partner to join our People team and support hiring across our growing, multinational organization. This role will report to the HR Manager and partner closely with hiring managers across Technology, Go\-to\-Market, HR/Workforce Management, and corporate functions.



This is a hands\-on talent acquisition role for someone who is comfortable working across different functions, seniority levels, countries, and time zones. The ideal candidate understands how recruiting works in a multinational environment and can adapt sourcing and hiring practices to different talent markets while maintaining a consistent, high\-quality candidate experience.



You will manage the recruiting process from role intake and sourcing through interviews, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff, while keeping hiring managers informed and ensuring our ATS and recruiting data remain accurate and current.


**What You'll Do**



Global Talent Acquisition


* Manage full\-cycle recruiting for roles across Technology, Go\-to\-Market, HR/Workforce Management, and corporate functions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, define role requirements, establish interview processes, and develop realistic hiring timelines.
* Develop sourcing strategies based on the role, location, seniority, and local talent market.
* Source both active and passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, professional networks, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
* Conduct candidate screening and initial interviews, assess qualifications against established requirements, and provide clear candidate feedback to hiring managers.
* Coordinate interviews and maintain momentum throughout the hiring process.
* Manage offer processes in partnership with the HR Manager and hiring managers.
* Complete recruiting activities and provide a clear handoff to HR for onboarding and new hire setup.
* Maintain consistent communication with candidates throughout the process and help deliver a strong candidate experience.


Global \& Multinational Recruiting


* Recruit across multiple countries and regions, including North America, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC.
* Understand how recruiting practices, talent availability, compensation expectations, employment considerations, and time zones can differ by market.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines in both established and emerging hiring markets.
* Coordinate effectively with candidates and hiring managers across multiple time zones.
* Develop practical sourcing strategies that balance talent quality, location, and cost considerations.


Recruiting Operations \& Process


* Manage candidate activity and workflows in Greenhouse, ensuring accurate candidate records, stage movement, interview feedback, and data hygiene.
* Create and maintain job postings, candidate outreach, interview plans, and scorecards.
* Track recruiting activity and provide regular reporting on pipeline health, time\-to\-fill, offers, hiring activity, and sourcing effectiveness.
* Help identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes, candidate experience, and hiring manager effectiveness.
* Maintain organized recruiting documentation and ensure processes are followed consistently.
* Support recruiting projects and process improvements as the company and hiring needs evolve.


Employer Branding \& Talent Engagement


* Develop compelling candidate outreach and job postings that accurately represent Globalli and the opportunity.
* Help strengthen Globalli's presence in relevant talent markets and professional communities.
* Support employee referrals, social sourcing, and other initiatives that expand our talent pipeline.


**What You'll Bring**



Must\-Have Qualifications


* 3\+ years of full\-cycle talent acquisition/recruiting experience, preferably in a fast\-paced technology, SaaS, startup, or multinational environment.
* Demonstrated experience recruiting across multiple functions, such as Technology, GTM/Sales, HR/Operations, Finance, or other professional roles.
* Experience managing the recruiting lifecycle from intake through onboarding handoff.
* Experience recruiting across multiple countries or international talent markets.
* Strong sourcing experience, including hands\-on use of LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
* Experience working with an ATS, preferably Greenhouse, including candidate tracking, workflow management, reporting, and data hygiene.
* Strong candidate assessment, communication, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple open requisitions and competing priorities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working directly with hiring managers and clarifying or challenging requirements when needed.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.
* Reliable internet and a professional home\-office environment.
* Ability to maintain meaningful working\-hour overlap with the New York/Eastern Time zone.


Preferred Qualifications


* Experience recruiting for a global technology, SaaS, fintech, HR\-tech, payroll, or workforce management company.
* Technical recruiting experience, including engineering, SRE/infrastructure, data, or cloud roles.
* Experience recruiting GTM roles, including Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, or Marketing.
* Experience recruiting HR, payroll, implementation, workforce management, or other operational roles.
* Experience recruiting across North America, LATAM, EMEA, and/or APAC.
* Spanish or another widely spoken business language.
* Experience recruiting in a remote\-first or distributed organization.
* Experience working with compensation benchmarks and adapting recruiting strategies to different geographic markets.
* Experience supporting employer branding, talent communities, or recruiting analytics.

title: HR Recruiter
description:
HR \& Administration Executive / Manager – Vrinda Ayurveda

**Location:** Delhi NCR  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years

About the Role

Vrinda Ayurveda is looking for a responsible and people\-oriented **HR professional** to manage recruitment, employee coordination, HR processes and day\-to\-day workforce administration.

The ideal candidate should be capable of building a **structured, disciplined and performance\-driven work culture** while ensuring smooth coordination between management and employees.

Key Responsibilities

* Handle **end\-to\-end recruitment** including sourcing, screening, interviewing and onboarding.
* Recruit suitable candidates for sales, telecalling, business development, marketing, clinic and administrative roles.
* Maintain employee records, attendance, leave and documentation.
* Prepare offer letters, joining documents, HR policies and employee files.
* Conduct employee induction and coordinate training.
* Define and monitor **KPI/KRA\-based performance** for employees.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and maintain performance records.
* Handle employee grievances, discipline and workplace concerns professionally.
* Coordinate payroll inputs, incentives and salary\-related documentation.
* Develop and implement HR **SOPs, policies and processes**.
* Coordinate with department heads regarding manpower requirements and performance.
* Monitor punctuality, attendance, productivity and workplace discipline.
* Support employee engagement, retention and team\-building initiatives.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.
* Prepare regular HR reports for management.

Candidate Profile

* 2–5 years of experience in **HR, Recruitment, HR Operations or Administration**.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good knowledge of recruitment and employee\-management processes.
* Comfortable handling sales/telecalling and operational staff.
* Good organisational and documentation skills.
* Strong follow\-up and problem\-solving ability.
* Proficient in MS Office/Google Workspace and preferably HR/CRM software.
* Should be mature, professional, organised and capable of handling confidential matters.
* Experience in **Healthcare, Ayurveda, Wellness, Hospitality, Retail or D2C businesses** will be an advantage.

Key Performance Areas

**Recruitment \| Employee Retention \| Attendance \& Discipline \| KPI Management \| HR Documentation \| Training \| Employee Engagement \| HR Operations**

**Salary:** Competitive, based on experience \+ performance

What We Expect

We are looking for an HR professional who can **build systems, not just maintain records**—someone who can help Vrinda Ayurveda attract the right people, develop employees, maintain accountability and create a professional working culture.

Pay: ₹9,461\.18 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
